description: This file contains unit tests for the Github OAuth2 provider within the League OAuth2 Client library. It verifies authorization URL generation, token retrieval, user data fetching, and error handling.

classes.name: GithubTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Github OAuth2 provider, extending PHPUnit's test case framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the provider instance with mock credentials before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the mock environment after each test.

methods.name: testAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the generated authorization URL and its query parameters.

methods.name: testScopes
methods.description: Checks that scope parameters are correctly encoded into the authorization URL.

methods.name: testGetAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Ensures the authorization URL has the expected path component.

methods.name: testGetBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Confirms that the base access token URL has the correct path.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Mocks a token response and verifies correct parsing of the access token and related data.

methods.name: testGithubEnterpriseDomainUrls
methods.description: Tests OAuth URL methods and token fetching with a custom enterprise domain.

methods.name: testUserData
methods.description: Simulates fetching user data and verifies the user object properties and array representations.

methods.name: testUserEmails
methods.description: Test method stub for email fetching; commented out in the source.

methods.name: testExceptionThrownWhenErrorObjectReceived
methods.description: Ensures proper exception handling when an error object is returned from the API.

methods.name: testExceptionThrownWhenOAuthErrorReceived
methods.description: Ensures proper exception handling when OAuth error response is received.
